ayahOccurrences.text: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا

ayahOccurrences.text: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا

ayahOccurrences.text: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا

ayahOccurrences.text: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَعَتَوْا۟ is in the derivative form: عَتَى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ت/و-ي ʿ–t–w/y to be excessively fierce, arrogant, violent, aggressive, to be disobedient, to offer mutinous opposition
; (of tree branches) to dry up; to reach very old age, to be infirm.

Of this root, 4 forms occur 10 times in the Qur’an:
عَتَى ʿatā 5 times; عُتُوٌّ ʿutuww 2 times; عِتِىٌّ ʿitiyy 2 times and عَاتِيةٌ ʿātiyatun 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَتَى ʿatā ū [v. intrans.]

1 to behave arrogantly, to violate the bounds of propriety, to become excessive

(25:21) لَقَدِ‏ ‏اسْتَكْبَرُوا‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏ ‏وَعَتَوْا‏ ‏عُتُوًّا‏ ‏كَبِيرًا‏ they have become too proud of themselves, and flagrantly violated all bounds of propriety

2 [with prep.عَن ] to rebel against, to turn with disdain from obeying

(51:44) فَعَتَوْا‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏أَمْرِ‏ ‏رَبِّهِمْ‏ ‏فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ‏ ‏الصَّاعِقَةُ‏ but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them.

entries.label: ع-ت-و-ي
entries.definitionHtml:
ع/ت/و-ي ʿ–t–w/y to be excessively fierce, arrogant, violent, aggressive, to be disobedient, to offer mutinous opposition
; (of tree branches) to dry up; to reach very old age, to be infirm.

Of this root, 4 forms occur 10 times in the Qur’an:
عَتَى ʿatā 5 times; عُتُوٌّ ʿutuww 2 times; عِتِىٌّ ʿitiyy 2 times and عَاتِيةٌ ʿātiyatun 1 time.

entries.label: عَتَى
entries.definitionHtml:
عَتَى ʿatā ū [v. intrans.]

1 to behave arrogantly, to violate the bounds of propriety, to become excessive

(25:21) لَقَدِ‏ ‏اسْتَكْبَرُوا‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏ ‏وَعَتَوْا‏ ‏عُتُوًّا‏ ‏كَبِيرًا‏ they have become too proud of themselves, and flagrantly violated all bounds of propriety

2 [with prep.عَن ] to rebel against, to turn with disdain from obeying

(51:44) فَعَتَوْا‏ ‏عَنْ‏ ‏أَمْرِ‏ ‏رَبِّهِمْ‏ ‏فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ‏ ‏الصَّاعِقَةُ‏ but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them.

entries.label: عَاتِى
entries.definitionHtml:
عَاتِى ʿātı [act. part.] violent, fierce, raging

(69:6) وَأَمَّا‏ ‏عَادٌ‏ ‏فَأُهْلِكُوا‏ ‏بِرِيحٍ‏ ‏صَرْصَرٍ‏ ‏عَاتِيَةٍ‏ as for the people of ʿād, they were destroyed by a violent roaring wind.

entries.label: عُتُوٌّ
entries.definitionHtml:
عُتُوٌّ ʿutuww [v. n.] violating all bounds of propriety, insurrection, arrogance

(25:21) ‏لَقَدِ‏ ‏اسْتَكْبَرُوا‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏أَنْفُسِهِمْ‏ ‏وَعَتَوْا‏ ‏عُتُوًّا‏ ‏كَبِيرًا‏ they have become too proud of themselves and flagrantly violated all bounds of propriety.

entries.label: عِتِىٌّ
entries.definitionHtml:
عِتِىٌّ ʿitiyy [v. n.]

1 being dried up, becoming too old, infirmity

(19:8) ‏وَقَدْ‏ ‏بَلَغْتُ‏ ‏مِنَ‏ ‏الْكِبَرِ‏ ‏عِتِيًّا‏ and I have reached the infirmity of old age

2 unruliness, being rebellious, brutality

(19:69) ثُمَّ‏ ‏لَنَنْزِعَنَّ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏كُلِّ‏ ‏شِيعَةٍ‏ ‏أَيُّهُمْ‏ ‏أَشَدُّ‏ ‏عَلَى‏ ‏الرَّحْمَنِ‏ ‏عِتِيًّا‏ then will We seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy.
